title: Inspection Photo Log Upload Lag
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:photo trade=* captured_epoch=* uploaded_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((uploaded_epoch-captured_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by trade
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures photo upload lag by trade for inspection photo logs.
value: Lag tracking shows which trade create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside inspection photo logs.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `photo upload lag` on `reno:photo` events and aggregate them by `trade`.
visualization: Table of trade with average and worst photo upload lag.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how long things take for each trade so you can see where inspection photo logs slows down.
